name: Utsumi Hinowa
source:
She is the caretaker and best friend of Aina, who arrived on land due to being "tainted".

Originally, she had a strong religious belief and was going to worship Aina as a god, but this changed when interacting with her.

She is not only Aina's best friend, but also the first person who treated her as an equal after she became a human being.

[translated from [url=http://wonder-fool.jp/ningyohime/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
